title: 第19章 公主下落第20章 离去
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
王贵妃在宫中察觉到异样，身形一闪，便也踏空而行，稳稳地立于半空之中，与鱼朝恩形成了对峙之势。
她一身华贵的宫装随风轻摆，面容冷峻，眼神中透露出不容置疑的威严。
就在这时，江辰姗姗来迟，他远远地看着半空中的对峙，心中不由得一阵惊叹。
他没想到，这王贵妃竟然也是一名天人境的高手，实力之强，丝毫不逊色于在场的任何一人。
“真是没想到，这王贵妃竟然也是此等高手。”
江辰喃喃自语，目光紧紧锁定在半空中的两人身上，生怕错过任何一个细节。
此刻的局势，已经变得愈发紧张。
鱼朝恩与王贵妃之间的气氛，仿佛凝固了一般，空气中弥漫着浓浓的火药味。
一场大战，似乎一触即发。
“鱼朝恩！
你好大的胆子，竟敢擅闯本宫的地盘，莫非是想造反不成？”
王贵妃的声音清冷而有力，如同寒冰刺骨，让人心生寒意。
鱼朝恩闻言，嘴角勾起一抹冷笑，眼中却已经露出了丝丝狠戾的光芒。
他虽心知王贵妃身份尊贵，实力非凡，但此刻却已骑虎难下，只能硬着头皮继续前行。
“贵妃娘娘，小人也是奉命行事，请您让开，不要让小人为难。”
鱼朝恩嘴上虽客气，眼中却闪过一抹狠辣的光芒。
贵妃又如何，鱼朝恩心中冷笑，他又不是没有杀过位高权重之人。
在这皇宫之中，权力与生死往往只在一念之间。
若公主确实是在王贵妃的宫里，那么王贵妃今日必定难逃一死。
毕竟，玉灵公主可不是普通公主，她的身上藏着一个连明皇都为之密切关注的大秘密，这个秘密一旦泄露，后果不堪设想。

“若我今日不让呢？”
王贵妃的声音坚定，她知道今天若是此事泄露出去，他们王家都要被荡然无存。
“凝！”
就在这时，天空之中突然传来一道雄厚而威严的声音，仿佛是天神降临，令人心生敬畏。
这道声音仿佛带有某种神奇的力量，王贵妃的身体瞬间僵在了原地，就像是被无形的冰霜封印了一般，无法动弹分毫。
鱼朝恩见状，心中大喜，知道是明皇出手了。
他立刻身形一闪，如同鬼魅一般冲进了王贵妃的府中，开始仔细搜查起来。
他深知时间紧迫，必须尽快找到公主，时间被一拖久，事情就会变得更加棘手。
鱼朝恩在府中四处搜寻，不放过任何一个角落。
他的目光锐利如鹰，任何一丝风吹草动都逃不过他的感知。
他心中暗自祈祷，希望能够在最短的时间内找到公主，将她安全带回宫中。
那些宫女们站在旁边，被吓得瑟瑟发抖。
但直到一炷香的时间过去了，鱼朝恩依旧一无所获。
孟望津在外面，迟迟听不到里面的动静，一颗心逐渐沉入了谷底。
现在他心中后悔万分，为什么要把江辰带进来。
要是在王贵妃的宫里找不到玉灵公主的下落，恐怕为了平息王家的怒火，明皇甚至会将他都牺牲掉。
content_en:
Wang Guifei noticed something strange in the palace, and with a flash of her body, she also walked through the air, standing steadily in mid-air, forming a confrontation with Yu Chaoen.
She was wearing a luxurious palace attire swaying in the wind, her face was stern, and her eyes revealed unquestionable majesty.
At this moment, Jiang Chen arrived belatedly. He looked at the confrontation in mid-air from a distance, and couldn't help but feel amazed in his heart.
He did not expect that this Wang Guifei was actually a master of the Heavenly Realm, and her strength was not inferior to anyone present.
"I really didn't expect that this royal concubine would be such a master."
Jiang Chen murmured to himself, his eyes fixed on the two people in mid-air, for fear of missing any detail.
The situation at this moment has become increasingly tense.
The atmosphere between Yu Chaoen and Wang Guifei seemed to have solidified, and the air was filled with a strong smell of gunpowder.
A war seemed about to break out.
"Yu Chaoen!
You are so brave, you dare to trespass on my territory. Could it be that you want to rebel? "
Concubine Wang's voice was cold and powerful, like ice that bit the bones, chilling people's hearts.
Hearing this, Yu Chaoen raised a sneer at the corner of his mouth, but his eyes already showed a hint of ruthlessness.
Although he knew in his heart that Wang Guifei had a noble status and extraordinary strength, at this moment, he was unable to get off the tiger and could only bite the bullet and continue moving forward.
"My dearest concubine, this villain is also following orders. Please get out of the way and don't make things difficult for this villain."
Although Yu Chaoen's mouth was polite, a ruthless light flashed in his eyes.
So what about the imperial concubine? Yu Chaoen sneered in his heart. It's not like he has never killed high-ranking people before.
In this palace, power, life and death are often just a matter of thought.
If the princess is indeed in Wang Guifei's palace, then Wang Guifei will definitely die today.
After all, Princess Yuling is no ordinary princess. She hides a big secret that even Emperor Ming pays close attention to. Once this secret is leaked, the consequences will be disastrous.
"What if I don't let you go today?"
Concubine Wang's voice was firm. She knew that if this matter was leaked today, their Wang family would be wiped out.
"Condensation!"
At this moment, a strong and majestic voice suddenly came from the sky, as if a god had descended, which was awe-inspiring.
This voice seemed to have some magical power, and Wang Guifei's body instantly froze in place, as if it was sealed by invisible frost, unable to move at all.
When Yu Chaoen saw this, he was overjoyed and knew that Emperor Ming had taken action.
He immediately flashed, rushed into Wang Guifei's house like a ghost, and began to search carefully.
He knew that time was running out and he had to find the princess as soon as possible. If time was delayed for a long time, things would become more difficult.
Yu Chaoen searched everywhere in the house, not sparing any corner.
His eyes are as sharp as an eagle, and no slightest movement can escape his perception.
He prayed secretly in his heart, hoping to find the princess in the shortest possible time and bring her back to the palace safely.
The palace ladies stood nearby, trembling with fear.
But until one stick of incense passed, Yu Chaoen still found nothing.
Meng Wangjin was outside and couldn't hear the movement inside for a long time, and his heart gradually sank to the bottom.
Now he felt extremely regretful about why he brought Jiang Chen in.
If Princess Yuling's whereabouts were not found in Wang Guifei's palace, Emperor Ming might even sacrifice her in order to appease the Wang family's anger.
